newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1996 current account data out Friday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1996 current account data out Friday.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank will publish balance of payments data for December and the whole of 1996 at 1100 local time/1300 GMT Friday, a spokesman said.
The spokesman said last year's current account gap, foreign reserve levels and foreign direct investment data would be explained by the bank's economics department head Altamir Lopes.
The current account gap is widely expected to be some 3.0 percent of gross domestic product.
Monetary base results for December and 1996, including public sector debt and deficit figures, will be announced at 1100 local/1300 GMT Monday, he added.
